title: Trending now uses the most viewed products
summary: Replace featured/new catalogue discovery with a maximum of four products ranked by recorded recent product views.

changes.detail: Trending uses descending recorded product_views across the recent 30-day window, excludes unavailable products and never fills with unclicked catalogue products. Paginate analytics rows before ranking.
Separate most-viewed API mode and mobile query; reject old API responses without the mode marker. Preserve existing wishlist recommendations and full search/catalogue.

validation.name: Pending checks
validation.detail: Route regression tests, mobile typecheck, focused lint and browser checks pending. Uses existing recorded website product views; no new mobile analytics collection or database changes. Deployment not performed.
